body_excerpt: {"credits": [], "cve_id": null, "cvss": {"score": null, "vector_string": null}, "cvss_severities": {"cvss_v3": {"score": 0.0, "vector_string": null}, "cvss_v4": {"score": 6.9, "vector_string": "CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:N/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N"}}, "cwes": [{"cwe_id": "CWE-770", "name": "Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling"}], "description": "When using the affected versions of the `vibeio-http` crate, an attacker could craft a malicious HTTP/1.x request with a large chunk length (between `usize::MAX - 1` and `usize::MAX` inclusive) and send it, causing the server to crash (integer overflow panic in debug builds, split_to out of bounds panic in release builds).\n\nThis was fixed in `vibeio-http` 0.3.2 by erroring on the chunk length if it exceeds `usize::MAX - 2` (using `checked_add()` instead of `+` operator), preventing integer overflow.", "ghsa_id": "GHSA-fx4f-mhw4-qm7j", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-08-24T22:05:02Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-fx4f-mhw4-qm7j", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-fx4f-mhw4-qm7j"}], "nvd_published_at": null, "published_at": "2026-08-24T22:05:02Z", "references": ["https://github.com/ferronweb/vibeio-http/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#vibeio-http-032", "https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0181.html", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-fx4f-mhw4-qm7j"], "repository_advisory_url": null, "severity": "medium", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/ferronweb/vibeio-http", "summary": "vibeio-http has a DoS vulnerability in HTTP/1.x chunked encoding parser triggered by maliciously crafted chunk lengths", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-08-24T22:05:06Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-fx4f-mhw4-qm7j", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "0.3.2", "package": {"ecosystem": "rust", "name": "vibeio-http"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "< 0.3.2"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
